title: feat(nm2frm2lpr): neighbor-read of L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e1 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Same L-path readout with the +e1 turn (toward the 'holonomy wall') on the two-axis opposite seed. Establishes that on this seed the +e1 and -e1 turns are indistinguishable (both reverse HOLD, face fails), i.e. no in-plane chirality at the 2-axis seed.
